storage.corrupt: The stored data cannot be read. It has not been replaced. Export the original data before repairing it outside the app, then retry.
storage.unsupported: This data uses an unsupported format. It has not been replaced. Export the original data and open it with a compatible version, then retry.
storage.unavailable: Browser storage could not be read. Check browser settings and retry.
storage.conflict: This data changed in another tab. Your change was not saved; review the latest data before trying again.
storage.quota: The browser could not save because storage is full. Free space and try again.
storage.lock-unavailable: Safe writing is unavailable in this browser context. Open the app in a supported, secure browser context.
storage.writeFailed: The change could not be saved. Check browser storage and try again.
storage.savedRefreshFailed: Your change was saved, but the display could not be refreshed. Retry reading instead of repeating the change.
storage.exportFailed: The original data could not be downloaded. Check browser permissions and try again.
storage.displacedDraft: An unsaved draft was left behind when its editor closed. Copy these values before dismissing them.
